display_name: Total SRBD Scale: Number of items answered without missing (Range: 0-22)
description:
Summary score for the Pediatric Sleep Questionnaire (PSQ) Sleep Related Breathing Disorder Scale. It is the number of items with a positive answer ("yes") divided by the total number of items answered. The score, ranging 0-1, above 0.33 is considered positive and suggestive of high risk for a pediatric sleep-related breathing disorder. [Chervin et al, 2000 (PubMed ID: 10733617)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/10733617)

[Search for all PSQ variables within this dataset](https://sleepdata.org/datasets/pats/variables?search=psq)
